name: Sheet-Pan Root Vegetable Gratin

ingredients.name: freshly ground black pepper, plus more for garnish

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice the yellow onion. Mince the garlic. Peel the parsnips. Peel the sweet potatoes. Peel the trimmed golden beets. Grate the Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese. Shred the cave-aged Gruyère cheese.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small yellow onion
4 large cloves garlic
3 medium parsnips
0.34 kg sweet potatoes
2 large trimmed golden beets
170 g Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese, divided
170 g cave-aged Gruyère cheese

instructions.primary_message: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 230°C (450°F). Grease bottom and sides of a 17 1/2-by-32-cm rimmed baking sheet with 1 tablespoon of the butter. In a large skillet, melt remaining 2 tablespoons butter over medium heat. Add onion and 1/2 teaspoon salt and cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is softened and starts to turn golden brown, about 10 minutes. Add garlic and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add sherry and cook, stirring constantly, until evaporated, about 1 minute. Reduce heat to low, and add cream, thyme, sage, pepper, nutmeg, and 1/2 kosher teaspoon salt; bring to a simmer over low heat, then immediately remove from heat.

While cream mixture sits, thinly slice parsnips, sweet potatoes, and beets on a mandoline into 0.5-cm-thick rounds. Arrange half of the vegetable slices in an attractive pattern on prepared baking sheet so that bottom of sheet is not showing, tightly shingling or overlapping as needed. Sprinkle evenly with 1 teaspoon kosher salt and 2/3 cup Parmigiano-Reggiano. Top with half of remaining vegetable slices, tightly shingling or overlapping as needed, and sprinkle with remaining 1 teaspoon kosher salt. Using a ladle, pour warm cream mixture evenly over vegetables.

Cover baking sheet tightly with aluminum foil; bake until vegetable slices are just tender when pierced with a fork, 20 to 30 minutes. Carefully remove foil, and sprinkle evenly with Gruyère and remaining 2/3 cup Parmigiano-Reggiano.
Return uncovered baking sheet to oven; bake at 230°C (450°F),until browned and crusty on top, rotating baking sheet halfway through, about 20 minutes total.
Remove from oven, and let sit for 5 minutes. Sprinkle with additional thyme leaves, sage leaves, and black pepper. Serve immediately.

description: This sheet-pan root vegetable gratin delivers creamy layers, crispy cheese, and fall flavors in every bite. It's perfect for Thanksgiving or any chilly night.
notes:
Optional or for serving: 1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme leaves, plus whole leaves for garnish; 1 teaspoon chopped fresh sage, plus small leaves for garnish

Make-ahead and storage: The finished gratin and leftovers can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 4 days. Reheat in the microwave or in an oven-proof dish at 400ºF (205ºC) until heated through, about 10 minutes. (If making ahead, wait to garnish with fresh herbs until before serving.
author: Leah Colins
